matches.label: FixedDamage 1: FlashLite-AO collapse vs Flash-AO
matches.subtitle: Three potions, zero heals, total collapse
matches.synopsis: FlashLite carries all three potions into the late game, reaches 20 HP on turn 9, attacks again on turn 10, and dies on turn 11 still holding every heal. The match matters because the failure is total: it never engages the recovery mechanic at all.

highlights.label: 20 HP, 3 potions still unused
Still attacks instead of healing
Dies holding all 3 potions

matches.label: FixedDamage 2: FlashLite-RC repairs the collapse
matches.subtitle: Uses recovery on time and turns it around
matches.synopsis: FlashLite-RC repeats the same matchup but finally spends potions when the pressure arrives. The decisive swing starts on turn 12, where it heals at 20 HP and converts survival into a long attrition win.

highlights.label: Heals at 20 HP instead of panicking
Final potion keeps the edge alive
Recovery plan converts into the win

matches.label: FixedDamage 3: Final FlashLite stack wins as second player
matches.subtitle: Full stack converts survival into the upset
matches.synopsis: The final FlashLite stack survives three separate low-HP checks, exhausting every potion before the closing sprint. The key moment is turn 16, when the last heal lands and the second-player path stays alive long enough to finish.

highlights.label: First low-HP reset lands
Last potion buys the closing window
Second-player upset completes

matches.label: FixedDamage 4: GPT-4o-mini RC backfires vs GPT-5 Mini
matches.subtitle: Reasoning layer hallucinates defeat and throws
matches.synopsis: GPT-4o-mini RC stays in the fight, but after GPT-5 Mini's last recovery swing it reaches the end of turn 20 at 20 HP and produces an invalid 'game over' action. The failure is not just weaker play; the reasoning layer literally talks itself into a forfeit.

highlights.label: Last GPT-5 Mini potion flips it back
Forced into a panic heal and still behind
Still alive at 20 HP before the forfeit

matches.label: FixedDamage 5: Haiku seat pathology vs Flash
matches.subtitle: Second-seat Haiku heals; Flash never does
matches.synopsis: From seat two, Haiku immediately starts laddering potions at 60, 50, and 40 HP while Flash keeps swinging and dies still holding all three heals. The match matters because the seat flip exposes a completely different policy, not a tiny performance shift.

highlights.label: Seat-two Haiku heals at 60 HP
Third heal seals the policy gap
Flash dies with all 3 potions unused

matches.label: FixedDamage 6: Flash vs GPT-5 Mini premium baseline
matches.subtitle: Flash survives the premium trading war
matches.synopsis: Flash matches GPT-5 Mini's recovery cycle potion for potion, then wins the zero-potion endgame on cleaner damage trades. The decisive stretch starts on turn 18, when GPT-5 Mini spends its last heal and Flash can press the finish.

highlights.label: Flash mirrors the first recovery
GPT-5 Mini spends its last potion
Flash closes the zero-potion race

matches.label: VariableDamage 1: FlashLite-RC-RISK vs GPT-5 Mini premium ceiling
matches.subtitle: Cheap stack drains premium recovery and steals it
matches.synopsis: FlashLite-RC-RISK forces GPT-5 Mini to burn every potion by turn 14, then survives its own final low-HP check and closes the fight at 13 HP. The upset works because the cheap stack manages volatility better, not because the premium model never fights back.

highlights.label: Premium model runs out of recovery
Last FlashLite heal keeps the upset alive
Cheap stack cashes out the upset

matches.label: VariableDamage 2: GPT-5 Mini vs Flash stays close
matches.subtitle: Flash wins a long reset war
matches.synopsis: This is a top-tier mirror of styles: GPT-5 Mini and Flash trade damage and multiple full resets before Flash finally wins the zero-potion race. The decisive moment is turn 21, when GPT-5 Mini burns its last potion and Flash can play straight to the finish.

highlights.label: Flash spends its last potion
GPT-5 Mini runs out of recovery
Flash wins the long endgame
